dialogues.jp: 時間をセットして布団の中に入る。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm clock, I return to my bed.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm clock, I return to my bed.

dialogues.jp: 頭を枕にのせ、天井を見つめる。――顔が｛ほころ／綻｝ぶ。
dialogues.en:
I lay my head on the pillow, and stared into the ceiling.
--A smile slowly lit up my face.
dialogues.text:
I lay my head on the pillow, and stared into the ceiling.
--A smile slowly lit up my face.

dialogues.jp: 休み前日の学園は、いつも楽しみだ。
dialogues.en: The last day of school is always fun.
dialogues.text: The last day of school is always fun.

dialogues.jp:
目を｛つむ／瞑｝り、｛まぶた／瞼｝の裏にこれからのバラ色の日々を
映し出す。
dialogues.en: I feel my eyelids getting heavier, and slowly close my eyes.
dialogues.text: I feel my eyelids getting heavier, and slowly close my eyes.

dialogues.en: T'is the best way of falling asleep.
dialogues.text: T'is the best way of falling asleep.

dialogues.jp:
休み前日の学園は嫌いじゃない。俺は目覚まし
をセットすると、ウキウキしながら、眠りにつ
いた。
dialogues.en:
The last day of school is always a fun time. After setting
the alarm clock, I slowly fall asleep grinning, with that
thought in mind.
